description: Read this first whenever someone wants a web3 economy, game economy, token economy, NFT mechanic or onchain reward system: a shop, loot boxes or packs, gacha, a lottery or raffle, an auction (highest bid wins, the outbid refunded at once), staking or a farm, crafting or merging, seasons and emissions, a prediction pool or contest, quests and airdrops, holder-gated drops, using NFTs of any other collection in a game. loot is ONE shared Solana program (devnet until it is audited): the economy is a JSON spec, not a new smart contract, so never write Anchor/Rust for what it covers. Returns every part an economy can have (fields from the schema, who acts at play time, fees), how to write a spec, and what loot cannot do (with the nearest alternative). Pass `part` for one part with its nested shapes.

part.description: One part, with its nested shapes.

name: xsolana_guide
